7.1.2.2 Undefined Behaviour in OSEK OS
There are a number of cases where the behaviour of OSEK OS is undefined. These
cases represent a barrier to portability. AUTOSAR OS tightens the OSEK OS specifi-
cation by defining the required behaviour.
[SWS_Os_00304]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If in a call to SetRelAlarm the parameter "increment" is set to zero, the service shall
return E_OS_VALUE in standard and extended status .⌋
[SWS_Os_00424]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_00097
⌈The first call to StartOS (for starting the Operating System) shall not return.⌋
[SWS_Os_00425]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_00097
⌈If ShutdownOS is called and ShutdownHook returns then the Operating System
module shall disable all interrupts and enter an endless loop.⌋
caption: 7.1.2.2 Undefined Behaviour in OSEK OS

targets.why: OS backward compatibility with OSEK OS
